title: Sunspear skill
wikitext:
[[Sunspear skill]]s are [[PvE]]-only skills available to [[character]]s on [[account]]s with the [[Nightfall]] [[campaign]]. They each cost one [[hero skill point]] and are available from the [[hero skill trainer]]s at [[Pikin|Kamadan]], the [[Shiloh|Sunspear Great Hall]], and the [[Libeh|Command Post]] after reaching the first rank of the [[Sunspear rank|Sunspear title track]].

The skills are dependent upon one's [[Sunspear rank]], rather than an [[attribute]]. Because PvE-only skills cannot be unlocked, [[hero]]es may not use Sunspear skills. Since the [[Feedback:Game_updates/20120517|May 17th, 2012 update]], only [[Sunspear Rebirth Signet]] and [[Vampirism]] (due to [[Vampirism#Notes|a bug]]) continue to scale above Sunspear rank 5 (Sunspear Captain). All other skills reach maximum effectiveness at rank 5. 

While Sunspear skills are not linked to any attribute, three of them are affected by [[primary attribute]] ranks, making them less useful for other [[profession]]s. The [[Monk]] skill [[Seed of Life]] requires [[Divine Favor]] to increase its healing capability, the [[Assassin]] skill [[Critical Agility]] needs [[Critical Strikes]] to increase its duration, and the [[Paragon]] skill [["There's Nothing to Fear!"]] uses [[Leadership]] to extend its duration.
